description: Inspired by the mysteries of astrobiology and extreme cosmic environments, Team Bio-Hazard thrives where others cannot. Driven by curiosity about life beyond Earth and sharp analytical minds, we engineer breakthrough solutions that are truly out of this world.
summary:
These two pages of The Last Whisper: Abandoned But Not Forgotten show the beginning of astronaut Aira's journey and her first encounter with the robot Luna:   
Page 1 (Crash Landing & Dark Energy): Aira's spaceship suffers a navigation thruster malfunction caused by a mysterious interference and crash-lands on the Moon. Stepping outside, she witnesses a sinister "dark energy" erasing traces of human discovery—such as the Apollo landing site—and completely severing her communications with Earth. Amid the crisis, she spots a faint blue signal glowing from behind a rocky ridge.  
Page 2 (Meeting Luna & Heading to Mars): At the silent, abandoned Apollo 11 landing site, Aira discovers the source of the blue light: a dusty little robot named L.U.N.A. (Lunar Exploration Unit) that reactivates once she brushes off the lunar dust. Shortly after, a holographic entity called The Archivist appears, revealing that LUNA is only the beginning. To uncover the full truth behind "The Last Whisper", Aira and Luna launch into space on a new mission to Mars.
